caption:
Everyone wants an AI startup. Meanwhile homeowners will happily pay someone to clean gutters and wash high windows. 🪜

The playbook:
1. Pick one service
2. Register your business and get public liability insurance
3. Set up your Google Business Profile
4. On every job: door hangers on the street, a yard sign, and ask for a review

Working at heights is dangerous. Follow your local safety rules.

Found in my own saved reels and sorted by SaveSort. Sort yours free, link in bio.
